read.en: Applied Materials rose 0.5% on Nov 10 to $372.53, trading $364.23–382.14. It is above the 5-day ($352.9) and below the 10-day ($374.9), 30-day ($431.7), 100-day ($494.6) and 200-day ($445.9); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($404.16), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月10日上涨 0.5%，收于 $372.53，盘中区间 $364.23–382.14。股价位于 5 日（$352.9）均线上方，10 日（$374.9）、30 日（$431.7）、100 日（$494.6）和 200 日（$445.9）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$404.16），RSI 为 42。

read.en: No level changed: the $382.14 high pierced the $372.8–375.5 zone, but the close stayed under the 10-day ($374.9), and the $362.9 Nov 4 low held (Nov 10 low $364.23). Resistance is $372.8–375.5, then $382.1–390.1 (Nov 10 high, Oct 30 close) and $404.2 (SAR). Support is $362.9–364.2, then $343–353 (Nov 9 low, 5-day) and $329.3. A close above $375.5 would target $382–390; below $362.9, $343–353.
